title: Study of Twice Yearly Lenacapavir, Teropavimab, and Zinlirvimab in the Pediatric Population With HIV-1
official: A Phase 2/3, Open-label, Single-Arm Study in the Pediatric Population With HIV-1 to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics, Safety, and Antiviral Activity of the Long-Acting Regimen of Lenacapavir, Teropavimab, and Zinlirvimab Administered Twice Yearly
summary:
The goal of this clinical study is to learn more about the study drugs lenacapavir (LEN), teropavimab (TAB), and zinlirvimab (ZAB) to assess how it is absorbed, modified, distributed and eliminated from the body of young people (the pharmacokinetics (PK) parameters of the drugs). It will also check the safety, and tolerability of LEN in combination with TAB, and ZAB in participants living with human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1).

The primary objectives of this study are to evaluate the PK parameters, safety, and tolerability of LEN, TAB, and ZAB.
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals must be aged ≥ 12 to \< 18 years at Screening Visit 1 (SV1) and enrollment (Day 1).
* Weight ≥ 35 kg at Day 1.
* On a stable oral antiretroviral (ARV) regimen for at least 6 months prior to SV1.
* At least 1 documented HIV-1 RNA level measured between 6 months and 12 months (+ 2 months) prior to SV1. This and any other HIV-1 RNA measurements documented in this period must be \< 50 copies/mL (undetectable HIV-1 RNA level according to the local assay being used if the limit of detection is ≥ 50 copies/mL).
* A plasma HIV-1 RNA test \< 50 copies/mL (undetectable HIV-1 RNA level according to the local assay being used if the limit of detection is ≥ 50 copies/mL) within the last 6 months prior to SV1.
* Plasma HIV-1 RNA \< 50 copies/mL at Screening Visit 2 (SV2).
* HIV-1 susceptibility results to TAB and ZAB meeting specific protocol criteria.
* CD4 cell count ≥ 200 cells/mm\^3 at SV2.
* CD4 individuals ≥ 20% at SV2.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* History of an opportunistic infection or illness indicative of Stage 3 HIV disease.
* Life expectancy ≤ 1 year.
* Evidence of active pulmonary or extrapulmonary tuberculosis infection within 3 months prior to Day 1.
* Acute hepatitis of any cause \< 30 days before Day 1 visit.
* History of, or current clinical decompensated liver cirrhosis or severe hepatic impairment.
* Prior use of, or exposure to LEN, TAB, ZAB, cabotegravir (CAB) (oral or injectable), rilpivirine (RPV) (injectable), or any long-acting (LA) parenteral ARVs (ie, broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs)).
* Any exclusionary laboratory values at SV2
* Positive hepatitis C virus (HCV) antibody with detectable HCV RNA.
* Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection

Note: Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply.
